claim: ElastiCache Auto Scaling requires cluster mode enabled. Its listed limits include Valkey or Redis OSS (cluster mode enabled) clusters running Valkey 7.2 onwards or Redis OSS 6.0 onwards, data tiering (cluster mode enabled) clusters running Valkey 7.2 onwards or Redis OSS 7.0.7 onwards, and the instance type families R8g, R7g, R6g, R6gd, R5, M8g, M7g, M6g, M5, C8gn and C7gn. Auto Scaling is not supported for clusters running in Global datastores, Outposts or Local Zones.

values.display: not supported for clusters running in Global datastores

qualifiers.scope: node-based Valkey and Redis OSS clusters
qualifiers.condition: cluster mode enabled; Valkey 7.2 onwards or Redis OSS 6.0 onwards (Redis OSS 7.0.7 onwards for data tiering); listed instance families; not in Global datastores, Outposts or Local Zones

evidence.quote: ElastiCache Auto Scaling is limited to the following:
Valkey or Redis OSS (cluster mode enabled) clusters running Valkey 7.2 onwards, or running Redis OSS 6.0 onwards
Data tiering (cluster mode enabled) clusters running Valkey 7.2 onwards, or running Redis OSS 7.0.7 onwards
Instance type families - R8g, R7g, R6g, R6gd, R5, M8g, M7g, M6g, M5, C8gn, C7gn
Auto Scaling in ElastiCache is not supported for clusters running in Global datastores, Outposts or Local Zones.
